keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Atalanta 0, Inter Milan 1. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Atalanta 0, Inter Milan 2. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter Milan) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Federico Dimarco with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Petar Sucic replaces Hakan Çalhanoğlu because of an injury.
Goal! Atalanta 1, Inter Milan 2. Eljif Elmas (Atalanta) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Nicola Zalewski with a cross.
First Half ends, Atalanta 1, Inter Milan 2.

Goal! Atalanta 1, Inter Milan 3. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Marcus Thuram with a through ball following a fast break.
Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Manuel Akanji replaces Federico Dimarco.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Curtis Jones replaces Nicolò Barella.
Substitution, Atalanta. Jonathan Rowe replaces Eljif Elmas.
Substitution, Atalanta. Mario Pasalic replaces Éderson.
Goal! Atalanta 2, Inter Milan 3. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Nicola Zalewski with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Atalanta. Giacomo Raspadori replaces Nicola Zalewski.
Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Goal! Atalanta 2, Inter Milan 4. Petar Sucic (Inter Milan) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Lautaro Martínez replaces Francesco Pio Esposito.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Aleksandar Stankovic replaces Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
Goal! Atalanta 3, Inter Milan 4. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Jonathan Rowe.
Substitution, Atalanta. Gianluca Scamacca replaces Nikola Krstovic.
Substitution, Atalanta. Lorenzo Bernasconi replaces Raoul Bellanova.
Goal! Atalanta 4, Inter Milan 4. Franck Kessie (Atalanta) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Carlos Augusto (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
